page.layout: Single page, no printed text of its own. The visible title lettering and imprint are show-through from the reverse side, mirrored. Library stamp, shelf-mark numbers and handwriting sit in the centre and lower right.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The large mirrored title ("Dialogi ad Eusebio Philadelpho Cosmopolita in gallorum et cateranum nationum gratiam compellat...") and the faint mirrored imprint at the foot are show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. Round purple stamp: "BIBLIOTHEQUE DE GENEVE" with the Geneva arms. Handwritten pencil or ink numbers: "1090255" and "89/1212" (shelf and accession marks, not printed). Faint handwritten marks near the centre-left and a signature-like scribble at right are not printed text.
